name: @neuropause/workforce
description: NeuroPause Enterprise Management System — Wave 11 Enterprise AI Workforce Platform. Composes Waves 1-10 (unchanged) into a governed AI-native workforce: a workforce runtime and agent registry (lifecycle/identity/capabilities/permissions/sessions), department/business/industry AI workers, multi-agent collaboration, a planning engine, a reasoning engine (evidence collected from real sources — never fabricated), a governed tool runtime, enterprise memory, human collaboration (reuse Wave 4 HITL), an AI organization, autonomous workflows (governance-restricted), executive AI (real runtime data only), an AI marketplace, and a worker SDK. AI operates THROUGH the existing runtime, audit chain, HITL, execution engine, and business platform — it never replaces governance. Workforce runtime/registry/planning/reasoning/memory/collaboration/SDK/marketplace/governance are LIVE-VERIFIED in-process; external LLM/voice/translation/OCR providers are ADAPTER-VERIFIED; organization tasks/business work/AI conversations/enterprise knowledge are BUSINESS-DATA-PENDING (registries start empty; never fabricated); and autonomous financial approval, payroll, banking, tax filing, clinical decisions, and legal decisions are REGULATED-EXTERNAL — represented only, never executed autonomously. Every AI action is audited on the one chain with user/org/worker/evidence/reasoning/approval/replay id.
